$comment: Scanner versions as of the freeze. The monthly rescan runs TWICE: once with these versions (scan_pinned -> pure disclosure signal) and once with latest (scan_current -> disclosure + detection). Without that split, a rising decay curve has two possible causes -- the world learned more, or the tools got better -- and the headline claim is unsupported. See docs/DECAY.md.

npm-audit.how: npm is pinned via the node version; node 24.14.1 ships npm 11.11.0

osv-scanner.how: release binary, pinned in scan.yml OSV_SCANNER_VERSION

gitleaks.how: release tarball, pinned in scan.yml GITLEAKS_VERSION

sca-behavioral.how: first-party; the copy at the frozen tag

sbom.how: NOT PINNED at freeze time -- recorded as a known gap, see docs/DECAY.md

licenses.how: first-party; the copy at the frozen tag

knownDegradation: A pinned scanner will eventually stop running on a current CI image. When that happens it is recorded as a PER-SCANNER gap and the affected series is annotated on the chart -- never interpolated.
